name: CyberQ
description: CyberQ is a question-answer dataset designed for cybersecurity education, containing around 4,000 pairs of questions and answers generated by augmenting large language models with cybersecurity knowledge graphs. It aims to facilitate interactive learning for students and novice learners by providing validated and updated cybersecurity questions and answers.
reputation: A niche educational cybersecurity QA dataset with limited public adoption compared with major benchmark suites.
notes: Dataset generated using LLMs augmented with cybersecurity knowledge graphs; domain experts manually evaluated samples for correctness.
